Dr. Aaron Horschig, a physical therapist, demonstrates effective exercise techniques for severe knee pain due to patellar tendonitis. This video details a step-by-step approach to alleviate jumpers knee, focusing on specific knee pain exercises. Watch as he guides a patient through rehabilitation, showcasing the journey to a pain-free life.
